Investigators believe this is part of B.C.'s escalating gang conflict, with a torched vehicle found nearby linked to the killing. Gill had a history of drug-related convictions and alleged ties to a group in conflict with the Brothers Keepers gang.
title: 'Had a history of drug-related crimes': Dilraj Singh Gill shot dead in Canada, gang rivalry suspected

author: TNN
description: A one-year-old boy was allegedly kidnapped and strangled to death in Panchkula, Haryana. The accused, identified as Ajay, was arrested after posing as the child's father to abduct him from a crèche. Investigations are ongoing, with the boy's mother also being questioned.
title: Haryana horror: 1-year-old boy kidnapped and strangled to death by mother’s Instagram friend

author: TOI CITY DESK
description: A calamity unfolded in Nampally as a fierce blaze erupted, taking the lives of three victims and leaving five others potentially trapped in the ominous depths of a cellar. This inferno, sparked by combustible materials, ravaged a local furniture showroom, with rescue efforts hampered by suffocating smoke and extreme heat.
title: Hyderabad godown fire: 3 dead, rescue operations underway; showroom owner on run

author: TOI SPORTS DESK
description: Bangladesh has accepted the ICC's decision to replace its national team with Scotland in the upcoming T20 World Cup. The Bangladesh Cricket Board cited government advice regarding safety concerns in India as the reason for their refusal to travel. Despite repeated efforts and alternative proposals, the ICC did not agree to relocate Bangladesh's matches.
title: 'India is not safe for us': BCB's final word as they say 'accept ICC's decision'

author: TOI BUSINESS EXPERTS
description: Railway Budget 2026: Though budgetary support on infrastructure build remains critical, linking these investments to structural reforms will be essential.
title: Railway Budget 2026 expectations: 5 ways to drive growth engine for the Viksit Bharat

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: An intensive care unit nurse, Alex Jeffrey Pretti, was fatally shot by a US border patrol officer during an immigration operation. Family members described him as a compassionate US citizen distressed by immigration policies. While authorities claim he approached officers with a handgun, bystander videos show him holding a phone. His family vehemently denies accusations of domestic terrorism.
title: Who was Alex Jeffrey Pretti? 37-year old ICU nurse killed by ICE agent in Minneapolis shooting

author: PATHIKRIT CHAKRABORTY
description: Mirzapur's alleged gym-based conversion and blackmail racket mastermind, Imran Khan, was apprehended at Delhi airport attempting to flee to Dubai. Carrying a Rs 25,000 bounty, his arrest brings the total to seven. Police also sealed five linked gyms. The racket targeted young women, using morphed content for blackmail and conversion pressure.
title: Mastermind of Mirzapur's gym-based religious conversion racket arrested at Delhi airport

author: SANJAY SHARMA
description: Roy Glauber, the physicist who won the 2005 Nobel Prize in Physics, challenged a core assumption about how science works. In interviews reflecting on his career, Glauber argued that real scientific breakthroughs rarely emerge from strict deduction. Instead, they grow out of intuition, guesswork, and sustained curiosity. His reflections offer a powerful career lesson for young scientists and educators, questioning how science is taught and how creativity truly enters research.
title: Nobel Laureate Roy Glauber says science is guesswork, not perfect logic

author: TOI SPORTS DESK
description: Former India all-rounder Madan Lal backed the ICC's decision to replace Bangladesh with Scotland for the 2026 T20 World Cup, deeming it justified and timely. He suggested external influence led to Bangladesh's withdrawal, calling it a significant mistake that opens opportunities for Scotland.
title: 'Pakistan misguided Bangladesh': India's World Cup-winner's direct attack

author: TOI NEWS DESK
description: Speaking during the 130th episode of his monthly radio programme Mann Ki Baat, Modi highlighted the significance of the upcoming Republic Day and the constitutional values it represents. He also drew attention to the importance of January 25, which is observed as National Voters’ Day, describing it as a key occasion in the democratic calendar.
title: PM Modi urges eligible youth to register as voters during Mann Ki Baat

author: NITASHA NATU
description: A college teacher was tragically murdered on a local train at Malad station. An argument over alighting led to the fatal stabbing. The Government Railway Police have arrested Omkar Shinde in connection with the incident. The victim, Alok Kumar Singh, was a faculty member at Narsee Monjee College. Investigations are ongoing, with police examining CCTV footage and witness statements.
title: 'Simple guy, never got angry': College teacher stabbed to death on Mumbai local

author: TOI CITY DESK
description: The vital Srinagar-Jammu national highway remains shut for a third day due to fresh snowfall across Kashmir, stranding hundreds of vehicles. Snow clearance efforts are underway, but ongoing precipitation in Kulgam district is causing delays. Meanwhile, Srinagar city saw light snow, yet flight operations at the international airport continued without disruption.
title: Srinagar-Jammu highway shut for third consecutive day amid heavy snowfall; hundreds stranded

author: TOI BUSINESS DESK
description: A powerful winter storm has caused widespread US air travel disruptions, leading to over 13,000 flight cancellations and impacting major airports. Airlines are waiving change fees and offering rebooking options, but compensation for meals or lodging during weather-related cancellations is not guaranteed.
title: US snow storm cancelled your flight? Here's what you need to know

author: ADVITYA BAHL
description: A wedding procession in Greater Noida turned violent when a dispute over a ritual escalated, leaving six family members critically injured. Police have arrested two individuals and registered a case against 44 people, citing an old family rivalry as a potential motive for the attack.
title: 'Armed with pistols': After spat over wedding ritual, baraat attacked in Greater Noida; 6 critical

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: Alex Pretti's fatal shooting has again brought the spotlight on the poor training of ICE agents, and the whether they are fit to deal with protesters.
title: Did Alex Pretti have a gun? What we know about Minneapolis shooting

author: TOI SPORTS DESK
description: Virat Kohli's childhood coach, Rajkumar Sharma, supports the ICC's decision to replace Bangladesh with Scotland in the T20 World Cup 2026. This follows Bangladesh's refusal to participate as scheduled, citing security concerns that the ICC and independent assessments found unsubstantiated. The ICC's move aims to maintain tournament integrity and avoid setting problematic precedents.
title: 'ICC gave Bangladesh warning': Virat Kohli's coach slams Bangladesh

author: HEMANTA PRADHAN
description: Renowned music composer and singer Abhijit Majumdar passed away at 54 after a prolonged illness at AIIMS Bhubaneswar. He was admitted in September last year with a neurological disorder and multiple comorbid conditions. Despite initial recovery and plans for discharge, he succumbed to refractory septic shock and cardiac arrest on Sunday.
title: Music composer and singer Abhijit Majumdar passes away at 54

author: TOI TECH DESK
description: Intel's CEO expressed disappointment over unmet market demand, as the chip giant reported a significant quarterly loss and projected further losses.  Supply shortages and production ramp-up costs are impacting revenue, which fell short of expectations.  Despite government support and recent stock surges, the company faces execution challenges and disappointing fabrication yields, raising concerns about its turnaround strategy.
title: 'Not able to meet demands': Intel CEO Lip-Bu Tan gives shareholders ‘disappointing’ news

author: TANUJ LAKHINA
description: Sunrisers Eastern Cape captain Tristan Stubbs, who has had a mediocre return since the highs of 2024, is keen to find form in the SA20 final against the Pretoria Capitals. Having been called up to the T20 World Cup squad as an injury replacement, Stubbs has personal and team goals to achieve at Newlands in Cape Town.
title: SA20 Final: Stubbs hopes to make it three-in-four for SEC - preview

author: TOI SPORTS DESK
description: Shahid Afridi criticises the ICC for its perceived double standards after Bangladesh was removed from the 2026 T20 World Cup. He contrasts this with India's security concerns being accommodated for the 2025 Champions Trophy, highlighting a lack of fairness in global cricket governance.
title: T20 World Cup row: Shahid Afridi drags India–Pakistan angle, attacks ICC

author: TOI BUSINESS DESK
description: The US government is investing $1.6 billion in USA Rare Earth, acquiring a 10% stake to support a local mine and magnet production facility. This move aims to bolster domestic rare earth production, with the company also securing $1 billion in private funding. The investment includes government shares and warrants, priced near the company's recent trading levels.
title: US govt to get 10% stake in USA Rare Earth, Trump admin's push for domestic production

author: TOI NEWS DESK
description: National Voters’ Day is observed annually on January 25 to mark the foundation day of the Election Commission of India (ECI), established in 1950. The day aims to recognise voters, encourage youth participation, reinforce democratic values, and promote universal adult suffrage. In a post on X, the Prime Minister said National Voters’ Day is about “further deepening our faith in the democratic values of our nation”.
title: 'Voter a Bhagya Vidhata': PM Modi greets citizens on National Voters’ Day

author: RAUNAK BOSE
description: NBA trade deadline buzz sees Lakers eyeing a deal with the Kings. The proposed trade, involving Malik Monk, Keon Ellis, and Devin Carter going to LA for Dalton Knecht, Gabe Vincent, and Maxi Kleber, aims to bolster the Lakers' inconsistent bench scoring and defense. Sacramento would gain valuable assets and flexibility.
title: NBA trade rumors: Lakers weigh move for $26M Kings power trio to upgrade roster

author: TNN
description: A father and daughter tragically lost their lives when a heavy metal plate fell from an under-construction bullet train bridge onto their fishing boat on the Tapi River. The incident occurred near Kathore village, with the plate reportedly slipping from a crane. While the mother survived, the deceased were identified as Mohsin Shaikh and his nine-year-old daughter, Huma.
title: 2 die as bullet train bridge plate ‘falls’ in Gujarat

author: TOI SPORTS DESK
description: Music composer Palash Muchhal faces renewed cheating allegations from actor-producer Vidnyan Mane, a friend of Smriti Mandhana. Mane claims Muchhal was caught with another woman during pre-wedding festivities, leading to a physical confrontation with cricketers. Muchhal has denied these claims, initiating a Rs 10 crore defamation suit against Mane.  Several Instagram posts featuring Mandhana have also been removed.
title: Amid cheating claims, Palash Muchhal deletes all Smriti Mandhana photos

author: TOI ENTERTAINMENT DESK
description: Sunny Deol's 'Border 2' has made a strong debut, earning Rs 65 crore in its first two days. The war drama is projected to reach Rs 70 crore by its third day, solidifying its position as Sunny Deol's fourth highest-grossing film. The movie's success highlights Deol's continued box office appeal.
title: 'Border 2' box office collections day 2

author: TOI CITY DESK
description: The deteriorating air quality of Delhi witnessed a significant improvement after the winter rain showered the capital city, with the Air Quality Index (AQI) recorded at 151, in the "moderate" category at 7 am on Sunday, according to the Central Pollution Control Board (CPCB).
title: Delhi air quality improves to 150 after winter rain, with AQI in 'moderate' category

author: TOI BUSINESS EXPERTS
description: The government should definitely make a uniform policy for accredited investors but with fewer norms. And before angel investors, the government should look at F&Os as they are even riskier and more speculative. Angel investing drives capital formation.
title: Investors’ expectations from Union Budget 2026

author: AMIT KUMAR
description: Ravindra Jadeja's constant encouragement proved pivotal as Saurashtra's Parth Bhut dominated Shubman Gill, taking 10 wickets in their Ranji Trophy win over Punjab. Bhut, inspired by Jadeja, credited his hero's guidance for his match-winning performance and fulfilling a childhood dream of playing alongside him.
title: Ravindra Jadeja's 'attack kar' call sets up Shubman Gill's dismissal | Exclusive

author: TNN
description: A shocking plot unfolded when a routine cow slaughter seizure revealed a wife's elaborate scheme to frame her husband for a second time.  Driven by a desire for divorce, she allegedly conspired with her lover, using burner phones and fake identities to plant beef and ensure his arrest.  The investigation uncovered a chilling tale of betrayal and manipulation.
title: UP woman, wanting divorce, plants beef to frame husband in cow slaughter case

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: A second US citizen, Alex Jeffrey Pretti, was killed by Border Patrol officers in Minneapolis, weeks after another fatal shooting by federal agents. Footage shows officers tackling Pretti, who was holding a phone, and firing multiple shots even after he collapsed. Officials claim Pretti violently resisted disarming, but his family describes him as a caring nurse.
title: 'What did you just do!' Second killing in Minneapolis by US federal agents - video captures horror

author: BARSHA DUTTA
description: Taylor Swift recently admitted she once feared happiness could weaken her songwriting as her romance with Travis Kelce deepened. She worried that joy might replace the emotional tension that fueled her lyrics. However, her latest album proved otherwise, showing she can create vibrant, story-driven music even during one of the happiest chapters of her life.
title: Taylor Swift’s Kelce Romance Sparks Fears Her Songwriting Is Slowing

author: GLOBAL SPORTS DESK
description: Leon Draisaitl returned to the Edmonton Oilers after a short personal leave to attend to a family illness in Germany. The star center spoke on Saturday about how the experience taught him to see hockey from a different perspective. With Draisaitl back, Edmonton looks to find consistency heading into the Olympic break.
title: Leon Draisaitl opens up on family and NHL absence

author: MAHIMA ROY
description: Taylor Swift and Travis Kelce might have a lot to deal with in their lives over the last few weeks. Amid all the mess, there have been reports of their wedding being “put on hold” as Taylor Swift is focusing on being there for Travis Kelce after a pretty poor season on the field. But it seems, Travis Kelce is not doing well emotionally.
title: Travis Kelce shaken as Taylor Swift reportedly puts wedding plans on hold

author: MANABESH MOHANTY AND HEMANTA PRADHAN
description: A 70-year-old man in Odisha pedalled his rickshaw van 300 km to take his wife for medical treatment and is now returning home the same way, refusing help. His unwavering devotion highlights the struggles of the poor in accessing healthcare and transport, a story that has gained significant attention.
title: 70-year-old Odisha man cycles 600km to take ailing wife to hospital in rickshaw

author: ASHNI DHAOR
description: A young software engineer drowned in a Noida trench despite a massive rescue operation involving multiple agencies. Officials and the victim's father decried the "institutional failure," citing a lack of training, equipment, and coordination among first responders and specialized units. The tragedy exposed critical gaps in India's emergency response mechanism.
title: 80 rescuers, no saviour: Who let Noida techie Yuvraj Mehta drown?

author: KAUTILYA SINGH
description: Avalanche risks loom over the higher altitudes of Uttarakhand for the next 24 hours. Both locals and visitors are urged to steer clear of unnecessary journeys. There's a significant danger level 2 (Yellow) declared in various districts peaking over 2,800m, while Chamoli exceeds level 3 (Orange) above 3,000m.
title: Avalanche alert in Uttarakhand: Warning issued for high-altitude areas

author: TRENDING DESK
description: India celebrates its 76th Republic Day on January 26, 2026, commemorating the adoption of its Constitution. The grand parade on Kartavya Path will highlight military strength, cultural diversity, and technological advancements, with a special focus on the 150th anniversary of 'Vande Mataram'. Dignitaries from the European Council and Commission will attend as chief guests.
title: Happy Republic Day 2026: Top 50 wishes, messages, and quotes to share

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: A massive winter storm has caused widespread flight cancellations across the United States, with over 13,000 flights grounded between Saturday and Monday. This disruption is among the most severe in years, impacting major hubs from Texas to New England. Airlines and airports implemented contingency measures and winter preparations to mitigate the extensive impact.
title: Over 13,000 flights cancelled! US snow storm hits air travel, more disruptions expected

author: TNN
description: In a shocking incident that unfolded on a packed local train at Malad station, Alok Singh, a 33-year-old junior college instructor known for his passion for math and statistics, was fatally stabbed after a disagreement over exiting the train. The assailant, as of now unidentified, launched the attack in full view of other passengers.
title: 'Simple guy, never got angry': College teacher stabbed to death on Mumbai local

author: SEHJAL GUPTA
description: Alex Honnold will climb Taipei 101 live on Netflix on Saturday, Jan. 24, at 8 p.m. ET. The event, called “Skyscraper Live,” was delayed due to weather in Taiwan. Viewers can watch the full ropeless climb only on Netflix, featuring one of the world’s tallest buildings.
title: When will Alex Honnold’s dangerous Taipei 101 climb stream live on Netflix?

author: TNN
description: A shooting initially deemed accidental in Bodakdev has been reclassified as murder. Police now believe Yashrajsinh Gohil, nephew of Congress MP Shaktisinh Gohil, intentionally shot his wife Rajeshwari before taking his own life. Forensic and ballistic evidence ruled out accidental discharge. The investigation revealed the fatal shot struck Rajeshwari at the base of her head.
title: Ahmedabad flat horror: Congress MP Shaktisinh Gohil’s nephew shoots wife

author: TOI SPORTS DESK
description: Former India cricketer Atul Wassan slammed PCB chief Mohsin Naqvi’s remarks on possibly skipping the 2026 T20 World Cup, calling it “foolish bravado.” He said dragging politics into cricket hurts players, not administrators. Wassan felt Pakistan was backing Bangladesh for political mileage. His comments followed Naqvi’s criticism of the ICC after Bangladesh were replaced by Scotland for refusing to follow the tournament schedule.
title: 'Blackmail cricket world': PCB chief Naqvi under fire over pullout remarks

author: RAHUL SINGH
description: A Bijnor dog, celebrated by locals for its almost spiritual ritual of circling a Hanuman statue, has found refuge after intervention from animal rights activists. The dog's unusual behavior was traced back to a neurological condition caused by a tick-borne disease. Thankfully, Bhairav, the canine in question, has since received urgent veterinary care and is on a path to recovery.
title: ‘Divine’ dog had neuro trouble, rescued by vets

author: TOI SPORTS DESK
description: Suryakumar Yadav revealed how patience, time in the middle, and a social media break helped him regain form after a challenging period. He credited his wife's advice and a focus on match performance over net sessions for his improved confidence.  He also emphasized the importance of team wins beyond individual performances.
title: 'There's a coach at home': SKY reveals how his wife helped him rediscover form

author: VISHAKHA CHAMAN
description: A four-year-old girl in Faridabad was allegedly beaten to death by her father for a math assignment error. Neighbors reported the father, a private firm employee, frequently abused the child when drunk. The girl, Vanshika Jaiswal, was reportedly conditioned to avoid crying in front of him due to his violent reactions.
title: 'She stopped crying to survive': Father beats 4-year-old to death over maths homework

author: TOI SPORTS DESK
description: Former Bangladesh Cricket Board official Suyed Ashraful Haque has slammed the nation's withdrawal from the T20 World Cup, deeming it an unnecessary and detrimental decision. He argued that linking participation to an IPL player's exclusion was misguided, as ICC events boast superior security. Haque warned this move jeopardizes Bangladesh cricket's progress, with Scotland now replacing them.
title: 'Bangladesh overplayed its hand': Former BCB secretary slams T20 World Cup pullout

author: TOI WORLD DESK
title: ICE raids: Man shot and killed during Minneapolis immigration crackdown — 10 key points

author: SANJEEV VERMA
description: Himachal Pradesh grapples with severe disruption as heavy snowfall paralyzes transport, power, and water supply across multiple districts. Lahaul and Spiti remains cut off, with hundreds of tourists stranded in Manali. Authorities are working on a war footing to clear roads and restore essential services amidst freezing temperatures and significant snowfall in popular tourist spots.
title: Snow brings pain in Himachal Pradesh: Roads closed, no power & water supply; tourists stranded

author: AMIT ANAND CHOUDHARY
description: Supreme Court Justice Ujjal Bhuyan voiced strong dissent over the collegium's decision to transfer Justice Atul Sreedharan, citing executive influence. He argued that such transfers, especially when prompted by the central government, compromise judicial independence and the integrity of the collegium system. Justice Bhuyan emphasized the judiciary's reliance on public faith.

title: A penguin’s death march is going viral in 2026: What the ‘nihilist penguin’ meme means

author: AHMED ALI
description: Filmmaker Vikram Bhatt and his daughter Krishna Bhatt are facing a new fraud case in Mumbai, accused of cheating a Pune-based investor out of Rs 13.5 crore. The investor claims they were promised high returns on film projects but never received their principal or profits. The investigation has been transferred to the Economic Offences Wing.
title: Mumbai Police books Vikram Bhatt, daughter in Rs 13.5 crore cheating case
